findings.body: The staleness assertion fails on CRLF checkouts even when the command page is current. `sync.write_file` writes LF bytes (`src/forge/sync.py:85`), but this assertion reads the checked-out reference as raw bytes. `.gitattributes:1–2` does not enforce LF for Markdown, and the suite includes Windows runners (`.github/workflows/forge-next.yml:23–35`). Git for Windows [defaults to CRLF checkout conversion](https://github.com/git-for-windows/build-extra/blob/main/installer/install.iss#L2184-L2200). Normalize the reference with `read_text(encoding="utf-8").encode("utf-8")`, as the existing generated-document test does at `tests/test_trim_standards.py:17–18`, so checkout line endings do not produce a false staleness failure.
